Author: Birch
Name: Solution Nights
Punchline: Blackjack, hold'em and roulette over your linkshell.
Description: Play blackjack, no-limit Texas Hold'em and European roulette with friends over a cross-world linkshell, at a neon table in the spirit of Solution Nine. One player hosts and deals; everyone else joins from the lobby. Animated tables, encrypted hole cards, provably fair shuffles, host-approved buy-backs, practice tables against bots, an adjustable interface size and a chip ledger for the host. Chips are play money: the plugin never trades gil. (Formerly Saucer Nights.)
